results.evidence: The patch calls `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)` unconditionally when redirectToInsight is true. The comment says the panel floats below 1200px, but there is no check that the panel is in its overlay presentation. It closes the panel in every presentation. Closing it in overlay mode is covered, but the criterion is about the overlay case specifically and c3 requires the condition. I can't confirm from the shown code that setScenePanelOpen exists on sceneLayoutLogic, and I can't see how it works. The behaviour for the overlay case is probably met, but I'm unsure of the action's existence and semantics.

`lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` still runs before the block. Inside `if (redirectToInsight) { ...setScenePanelOpen(false); router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id)) }`, the push still happens after closing the panel.

The close is unconditional inside `if (redirectToInsight)`: `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)`. No check for overlay versus docked presentation, so a docked panel on a wide screen would also be closed.

Both call sites now pass the short id: `urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!, insight.short_id)`. `urls.resourceTransfer` adds `combineUrl(path, { insight_short_id: insightShortId }).url` to the URL.
ResourceTransfer reads `searchParams.insight_short_id` and passes it to `sourceResourceUrl`, which for Insight returns `urls.insightView(insightShortId as InsightShortId)` when present.
`return insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId as InsightShortId) : urls.insights()` falls back to the insights list when the short id is missing.

Dashboard and Survey cases still return `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and `urls.survey(resourceId)`. `resourceTransfer` only adds the param when `insightShortId !== undefined`, and other callers do not pass it.

The card has the `@container/subscription-empty-state` class. The illustration is wrapped in `<div className="hidden shrink-0 @min-[24rem]/subscription-empty-state:block">`, so it is hidden below 24rem and shown beside the text above that. Because the illustration is hidden when narrow, the remaining text content fits the narrow card. The criterion also allows the illustration to no longer sit beside the text, so hiding meets it.
